label: diazepam 10 mg oral, young healthy adults, n=11, plasma
note: Swift CG, Ewen JM, Clarke P, Stevenson IH. Br J Clin Pharmacol 1985;20(2):111-118, p.115 Table 2, row 'Young (n = 11)' (PMC1400684, scanned page). Composite profile: the 0.5-6.5 h samples follow a morning dose and the 10-16 h samples a separate night dose in the same subjects, so the authors computed no NCA parameters; the flat 10-14 h means likely reflect that. Fed state not reported. Sparse early sampling (0.5 then 2.5 h) misses Tmax. No LLOQ printed.
